# Chris Kresser

> > Evidence-based functional medicine and ancestral health guidance for reversing chronic illness and optimizing health through personalized nutrition and microbiome science.

Chris Kresser is a leading functional medicine practitioner and health educator who combines ancestral nutrition principles with modern scientific research. The site offers comprehensive guides, articles, podcasts, practitioner training programs, and a directory of ADAPT-trained functional medicine professionals.

## Key Topics

- Functional Medicine
- Gut Microbiome
- Dysbiosis
- Chronic Disease Reversal
- Ancestral Health
- Microbiome-Gut-Brain Axis
- Personalized Nutrition
- Digestive Health
- Longevity
- ADAPT Practitioner Training
- Health Coaching
- Nutrient Supplementation
- Paleo Diet
- Autoimmune Disease
- Revolution Health Radio

## Core Resources & Guides

- [Reverse Chronic Illness](https://chriskresser.com/reverse-chronic-illness): Comprehensive guide to reversing chronic illness via functional medicine and ancestral health principles
- [The Gut Microbiome](https://chriskresser.com/the-gut-microbiome): In-depth guide to gut microbiome health, dysbiosis management, and microbial restoration
- [eBooks and Resources](https://chriskresser.com/ebooks-resources): Health Solutions Library with downloadable eBooks and resources for chronic disease management
- [Articles Archive](https://chriskresser.com/articles): Searchable archive of evidence-based articles covering nutrition, microbiome, sleep, and health topics

## Practitioner Training & Directory

- [Find an ADAPT Trained Health Professional](https://directory.chriskresser.com): Searchable directory of ADAPT-trained functional medicine practitioners and health coaches
- [ADAPT Trained Practitioners](https://training.chriskresser.com/ccfm): Directory and information on ADAPT-trained functional medicine practitioners at the California Center for Functional Medicine

## Podcasts & Featured Content

- [RHR: The Gut-Brain Connection: How Your Microbiome Affects Your Mental Health](https://chriskresser.com/the-gut-brain-connection-how-your-microbiome-affects-your-mental-health): Revolution Health Radio podcast episode on gut-brain axis, probiotics, and microbiome influence on mental health
- [RHR: Beyond the Gut: The Microbiome's Role in Sleep, Energy, and Longevity](https://chriskresser.com/beyond-the-gut-the-microbiomes-role-in-sleep-energy-and-longevity-with-dr-zain-kassam): Podcast with Dr. Zain Kassam exploring microbiome impact on sleep, energy levels, and longevity
- [RHR: Vitamin D: Why a Personalized Approach Is Best](https://chriskresser.com/vitamin-d-why-a-personalized-approach-is-best): Podcast on personalized vitamin D supplementation strategies and essential cofactor optimization
- [RHR: New Study Challenges the Plant-Based Longevity Myth](https://chriskresser.com/new-study-challenges-the-plant-based-longevity-myth): Podcast episode analyzing plant-based diet longevity research and optimal protein requirements

## Nutrition & Health Articles

- [Magnesium: An Essential Nutrient Most People Don't Get Enough Of](https://chriskresser.com/magnesium-an-essential-nutrient-that-most-people-dont-get-enough-of): Article on magnesium deficiency, supplementation strategies, and cardiovascular health benefits
- [Should You Take a Multivitamin?](https://chriskresser.com/should-you-take-a-multivitamin): Evidence-based examination of multivitamin efficacy and whole-food nutrition alternatives
- [Edible Mushrooms: An Ancient Remedy Rediscovered by Modern Science](https://chriskresser.com/edible-mushrooms-an-ancient-remedy-rediscovered-by-modern-science): Article on medicinal mushrooms, immune support mechanisms, and scientific research findings
